name: Ashe
notes: Frost Shot (P) needs no code of its own: its bonus is 'critChance x (critDamageMultiplier - 1) x AD' added to the normal hit, which is exactly the standard expected-value crit math the engine already applies to every basic attack (a crit deals critDamageMultiplier x AD, so the expectation is AD x (1 + critChance x (critDamageMultiplier - 1))); modelling P separately on top of the engine's own crit handling would double it.

Opens with Enchanted Crystal Arrow (R) at t=0; its travel after the 0.25 s cast is assumed negligible (an open question the dossier flags as low impact), so its damage is dealt right when the cast completes.

Attacks continuously; each attack while Ranger's Focus (Q) is inactive builds a Focus stack (capped at 4). The instant 4 stacks are up and the buff is not already running, Q is activated for free (no cooldown, no cast time, no mana modelled).

While Ranger's Focus is active (6 s), every attack is the empowered 5-arrow flurry: the driver zeroes that attack's normal (auto) damage instance and instead deals the flurry's full 'total damage per flurry' (110-130% of total AD by rank, with the same expected-crit treatment a normal attack gets) as its own 'Q' source, since the wiki says on-hit effects apply only once per flurry anyway and the dossier's rotation counts the flurry as Q's damage. Each empowered attack also resets the attack timer, so attacks free-run at windup speed for the buff's duration.

The wiki's claim that the very first flurry of an activation fires a bonus 6th arrow for +20% total damage has no support anywhere in the data bin (ShotsPerStrike is a flat 5 with no 6-arrow or 1.2x field on any rank), so it is treated as stale text and not implemented.

Volley (W) uses the primary 'Volley' bin object (60/95/130/165/200 base, +100% bonus AD), matching the wiki's leveling table and ddragon's cooldown line exactly; the four duplicate VolleyRank2-5 bin objects (a different, lower, total-AD-scaling formula) are treated as stale leftover data, per the dossier's open question.
Volley is cast on cooldown; its 0.25 s cast time delays the next attack (lockout) and its damage lands at the end of that cast, per the wiki's 'effect at cast time end' note.
Hawkshot (E) deals no damage and only grants vision, which does not matter in a stationary dummy fight with no fog of war, so it is never cast.
Mana costs (Q 30, W 55-75, R 100) are not modelled: nothing here plausibly caps casts inside an 8-15 s fight at level 16.
